names.en: Arrival of Dragon Snake with Dust Fog and Explosive Soul Wind
names.ru: Пришествие Дракона-Змея с Пыльным Туманом и Взрывным Ветром Душ

summary.text: Arrival of Dragon Snake with Dust Fog and Explosive Soul Wind is a compound immortal killer move Fang Yuan uses in the late Crazed Demon Cave fight. Giant Sun Immortal Venerable judges its core to be Luo Po Valley.

claims.text: Fang Yuan activates the immortal killer move Arrival of Dragon Snake with Dust Fog and Explosive Soul Wind while Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s golden fog covers most of the battlefield and Spectral Soul Demon Venerable’s hands slam into that fog.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable immediately wails. One hundred of his large black arms twist into dragons and snakes that breathe out dust and dense fog, then explode into countless wind blades that destroy Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s golden fog. Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, healing while avoiding Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, identifies the move’s aura and says the core is definitely the secluded domain of heaven and earth, Luo Po Valley.

The move is a compound killer move involving many paths and Gu worms. Fang Yuan’s thoughts are almost emptied while he must also keep other methods running, and one stated disadvantage of compound killer moves is that they expend too many thoughts. Even as his attacks decrease, he still uses this move to repel and suppress the two venerables.
